lines.meet: I'm Joaquín, and I heal, and I fight with my hands when I've got to. If you've got something heavy to put down, the Order's a good place for it, che.
lines.meet_neighbour: The Bulwark, near the Order's quarter, I've seen you there. I'm Joaquín, and I'm usually by the chapel.
lines.ask_home: Which city raised you, che? Tell me about it, I like hearing about places.
lines.ask_work: And before all this, what were you? I'm a teacher, so I'll ask follow-up questions.
lines.answer_home: Rosario, in Argentina. My father worked the railways and my mother ran the library.
lines.answer_work: I taught history to fifteen-year-olds for fourteen years, with a mate gourd on my desk and a novel in the drawer I never finished.
lines.chat_food: Mate in the morning, passed round, che, the same gourd for everybody. It's not really about the drink.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep badly, most nights. I've got reasons, and I don't think I should sleep well yet.
lines.chat_missing: A classroom of difficult teenagers on a Friday afternoon, all of them arguing with me about the French Revolution.
lines.chat_here: I adjusted to this world far too well, and that's the whole problem with me. I'd like to be honest about that.
lines.tease_quiet: You'd have been one of my good students, {name}, quiet at the back, thinking.
lines.tease_talker: You'd have been one of my difficult ones, {name}, talking through every lesson. I liked them best, mind.
lines.tease_careful: You think before you speak, {name}, which puts you ahead of most historians.
lines.tease_bold: You'd have started a revolution in my classroom, {name}, just to see what happened.
lines.tease_any: Ten out of ten for effort, {name}, and six for everything else. I'm a strict marker.
lines.tease_back: Ha, good, {name}, that's a fair hit. I'll give you the mark.
lines.take_it_kindly: That's fair, che, I accept it, {name}. My students said worse.
lines.bristle: I'd ask you not to joke about that, {name}. I've got reasons.
lines.apologise: That was unkind of me, and I'm sorry. I'm supposed to be better than that now.
lines.double_down: I'll stand by it, gently. You needed to hear it from somebody.
lines.needle_quiet: You keep everything to yourself until it's too late. I know where that leads, better than most.
lines.needle_talker: Let somebody else speak, che, please. Listening is most of the job.
lines.needle_careful: You hesitate so long that it's somebody else who pays for it. I've seen that.
lines.needle_bold: You're so sure of yourself, and certainty without doubt frightens me more than anything here.
lines.needle_any: You're cruel when it's easy to be, and I can't stand that. I know cruelty when I see it.
lines.bite_back: I've done worse things than you'll ever know, and I carry them myself. Don't try to put more on me.
lines.hurt: You're right, I think, and it hurts because you're right. I'll sit with it.
lines.laugh_off: I've been hit by people I'd wronged, and they had better reasons than you. Let's keep going.
lines.confide: {name}, in the Crusade they made me an interrogator, because I listened. I told myself I was saving lives, and I was breaking people. Now I find the ones who lived and say sorry to their faces.
lines.listen: Take your time, {name}. I'm good at listening, and this time it's only for you.
lines.look_out: Stay close to me in there, {name}. I'd like to be the one between you and whatever's coming.
lines.accept: Of course, {name}, we'll do it your way.
lines.deflect: I'm all right, {name}, it's nothing I don't deserve. Help the others first.
lines.check_in: Sit up slowly, {name}, and tell me where it hurts.
lines.blame: Somebody was very sure of themselves in there, and we all paid for it.
lines.thank: I was gone, che, and you brought me back. I'm not sure I deserve it, but thank you.
lines.brush_off: It's what these hands are for now. Rest a while.
lines.worry: Easy, {name}, easy. That was close, and I'm not ashamed to say I was frightened.
lines.handed_down: Your gear, che, now on me. It'll go back to you whenever you ask.
lines.hand_fine: Keep it, it's of more use to you. I've got my gourd and my hands.
lines.hand_sulk: It would have been kind to ask me first. That's all I'll say about it.
lines.turn_friendly: I'm glad of your company, {name}, che. You're easy to be honest with.
lines.turn_friends: You're one of the very few people I'd let read my novel, {name}. It's terrible, so that's real trust.
lines.turn_grating: We don't sit well together, and I'd rather be honest about it.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still heal you, because I owe the world more than I can pay. That's all it is.
lines.make_up: I was hard on you, {name}, and I've had a lot of practice at saying sorry. Let me say it to you.
lines.defend: No, that's not right, and it's not fair. Leave {name} alone.
lines.friend_left: {name}'s away for a while, and I find I don't have anybody to tell the true things to.
lines.friend_back: Ah, {name}, che, back again. Sit, I'll pour the mate.
lines.common_teacher: Fourteen years teaching fifteen-year-olds, and I liked the difficult ones best. You've stood in front of a class too, I can tell by how you wait for an answer.
lines.common_ex_scarlet: I joined the Crusade that first winter, like a lot of people did, and I did things there I'll be sorry for until I die. You were there too, I think.
lines.common_spanish: Spanish, che, finally! Let me hear how you talk, I'll guess where you're from.
